description: This file defines the ActivateGroupCommandHandler class, which handles commands to activate groups within the Fineract platform. It implements the processing logic for 'ACTIVATE' actions on 'GROUP' entities, delegating to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ActivateGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing 'ACTIVATE' commands for groups, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: ActivateGroupCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the activation command by invoking the activation method on the write platform service.
